posts.linkedin:
Many small businesses answer the same customer questions every day without ever publishing them online.

A café owner spends the morning taking orders and the evening replying to the same WhatsApp messages. A gym coach repeats answers about class timings. A clinic receptionist types the address for every new patient. These repeated questions show what people type into Google, yet most business websites do not address them in a blog.

I provide a monthly set of SEO blog posts for small businesses across India. Each post answers one question that a real customer types into Google, using plain language instead of marketing jargon. The posts keep the website fresh with new content every month.

First the owner tells me what the business sells and which questions come up often. I then research the exact search queries behind those questions and write one article per month that answers them. The draft is sent to the owner for review, and the client pays only after approving the work.

When a customer searches for “best breakfast near me” or “café with wifi” at night, the answer is already on the site. The owner spends less time typing the same reply and more time running the business. New content also signals to search engines that the site is active, which can help it appear more often in search results.

This service is for owners who want a steady stream of helpful content without writing it themselves. It does not replace a personal reply when a customer has a complicated or urgent question, and it does not guarantee a top ranking or a specific number of visitors.

If you would like to discuss which questions your customers are likely searching for and whether a monthly blog fits your business, feel free to send a message. Payment happens only after you approve the work. DM BLOG
posts.bluesky: Most small business blogs never get found because they do not answer what customers type into Google. I write monthly SEO blog posts that answer one real customer question each. DM BLOG if you want honest advice on whether this fits your business.

Of course, no pressure. I can send a simple summary of what is included, the timeline, and how the approval process works. Is the hesitation about budget, timing, or whether blog content will actually bring enquiries? Payment is only after you approve the work.
